questions.question: If A ÷ B means that A is the father of B, A – B means that A is the mother of B, A + B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the mother of R?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98b3967bd39366008b36f4e5411a9aa5ad40a3a655b64060f129e83fc7ddd39a.png] 

From the given information:

 
 

 A ÷ B
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A – B
 A is the mother of B
 
 

 A + B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) Q – P + R means,

Q is the mother of P, P is the brother of R 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2a3cc4f447da7db8f81137d9e5a57b99cf60ff613d6a40eb503606f08c5619d.png] 

Here, P is the brother of R.

**Option 2) P – Q + R** means, 

P is the mother of Q, Q is the brother of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bd57e277b3eb9a241f8294a3aaa322bd292747c98041ee5fcb403d72bf85d8f.png] 

**Here, P is the mother R.**

Option 3) P – Q ÷ R means,

P is the mother of Q, Q is the father of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63ed1d5ccc97da7d7d58d968d5a08ce75cf423485938a4863677cd3f17b4fe95.png] 

Here, P is the grandmother of R.

Option 4) R + P – Q means,

R is the brother of P, P is the mother of Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e812658c1766616499477cec8be9474763349cb51520f8bf70b2baeaf7073049.png] 

Here, P is the Brother of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the % signs and to balance the given equation.

[{(32 % 28) % (6 % 4)} % (1 % 7)] % 5 % 20

Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face having ‘3’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb901ee284f6c5b61f024c8f1f0e00bd7b6af3be5bfa1ebf2644184bf6f4c346.png]
questions.solution:
When comparing figures 1 and 2, we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98beed1dfb35f9001aea014fa3f1e5af54e7a896cc22d7b3e81bae6869e7d85d.png] 

When '1' and '6' are visible in both dices, we get '5' and '2' are opposite to each other.

Now we compare figures 2 and 3, we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/403e05a41dbefe7956aff12721ed6aae18460062d1a73983ed141975c950be45.png] 

When '1' and '2' are visible in both dices, we get **'4' and '6' are opposite to each other.**

**Since there are six sides on a dice the remaining two sides will be opposite to each other i.e., '3' and '1'.**

So, the opposite of** '3' **will be** '1'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question: In the following question, four number pairs are given. In each pair the number on left side of (–) is related to the number of the right side of (–) with some Logic / Rule / Relation. Three pairs are similar on basis of same Logic / Rule / Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: First term × 3 + 3 = Second term**

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) 7 – 24

__**7 × 3**__ + 3 = 24

__**21 **____**+ 3**__ = 24

24 = 24

Option 2) 13 – 42

__13 × 3__ + 3 = 42

__39 ____+ 3__ = 42

42 = 42

**Option 3) 11 – 37**

__11 × 3__ + 3 = 37

__33 ____+ 3__ = 37

**36 ≠ 37**

Option 4) 5 – 18

__5 × 3__ + 3 = 18

__15 ____+ 3__ = 18

18 = 18

So, **11 – 37 is an odd one.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
